description: After request_action with payment_flow escrow: submits your EIP-712 signature of typed_data (ReceiveWithAuthorization). This grants the escrow's collector the authority to pull the stated USDC amount when the provider authorizes; no transfer happens on submission. If the provider does not authorize before the stated time the authorisation lapses; after the task deadline you can reclaim on-chain yourself (that call needs a little ETH on Base for gas).

signature.description: 0x-prefixed hex, 65 bytes or an ERC-6492 wrapper

name: submit_escrow_signature
title: Submit the escrow authorisation
